entries.title: transformers.js undeclared external (onnxruntime-common) — remove the scoped Module._resolveFilename patch when upstream declares it
entries.upstream_issue: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/issues/1087 (CLOSED unresolved — maintainer's repo-internal publicHoistPattern does not cover published consumers); fix in flight: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/pull/1764 (OPEN, maintainer-authored, contains the manifest declaration hunk)
entries.evidence: R75 judgement sweep 2026-09-22: deletion condition still unmet (Half-Fired Trigger — upstream declared onnxruntime-node/web, not the specifier actually required). 4.3.0 tarball dissection: dist/transformers.node.cjs top-level bare require('onnxruntime-common') at ~line 13520, manifest still undeclared. Runtime repro on pnpm isolated scope (hoist:false): 'Cannot find module onnxruntime-common' from transformers.node.cjs:13520 (transcript .scratch/grill-round-75/evidence/t0-pnpm-isolated-scope.log); 3.8.1 identical without patch, green with the shipped scoped _resolveFilename patch + self-declared copy. Nuance: pnpm default virtual-store hoist masks it; breaks under hoist:false / pnpm dlx / global-style installs; npm flat hoist masks until a version conflict (episodic-memory#105). Version-pairing discipline: self-declared onnxruntime-common must equal the effective onnxruntime-node embedded dep (currently 1.21.0 ≡ 1.21.0) — now a CI fact via packages/embedding/test/transformers-ghost-dep.test.ts (ADR-0076). Patch stays: fail-open, auto no-ops once upstream declares, and is the only mechanism that travels inside the published tarball.

entries.title: ESM arm for the transformers ghost-dep patch — module.registerHooks resolve fallback (named return ticket)
entries.evidence: R75 D-003 (B+): the shipped Module._resolveFilename patch only covers the CJS entry (transformers.node.cjs via createRequire().require()); a consumer reaching transformers.node.mjs through import()/import would bypass it — the ESM resolver cannot be scoped without module.registerHooks. Not adopted now: registerHooks is Stability 1.2 experimental, process-global, needs Node >=22.15 (repo floor >=22), is inert under jest/vitest loaders, and our reachable ESM surface is zero — runtime defense code for an unreachable path is negative value (Static Invariant Guard doctrine). The guard test transformers-ghost-dep.test.ts asserts the invariant instead. Re-entry triggers: (a) any src code path starts loading @huggingface/transformers via ESM import (guard goes red — by construction); (b) upstream merges #1764 and a release declares onnxruntime-common (patch + this ticket retire wholesale); (c) Node floor rises to >=22.15 AND a real ESM consumer exists — then implement registerHooks per GitNexus#2069 posture: fail-open, resolving onnxruntime-common from the effective onnxruntime-node copy (dynamic version pairing, no pin drift).
entries.monitoring_channel: guard test red = trigger (a); watch PR #1764 + releases >4.3.0 for trigger (b); Node floor changes for trigger (c)
